method: Read-only source/XML inspection; no reference executable, build, production database or runtime configuration was opened.

original_entry_and_calls.behavior: setupUi -> read three database snapshots -> original dynamic styles -> init_components -> calibrated projects -> initial view. Cancel reloads current project.
List projects whose result_type Calibration has is_used>0. Project selection rereads reagent groups, calibration batch associations and bases, then visible curves.
Visible curves filtered by project name. Date receives M if edited and C if referenced by Default batch. Current row/default selection does not itself apply a curve.

Clear previous point/date/batch/detail/plot before looking up selection. Current Calibration result unit, multiplier and decimals come from project. Original/test decimals come from project params. Read points by calibration_id. Disable Audit when is_checked.

Save asks confirmation, updates selected base datetime/is_edited and reads edited table. Copy asks confirmation, allocates calibration_total_count, inserts new base and copies loaded committed points, ignoring unsaved point edits. No explicit role gate in these slots. Original does not reset is_checked on save/copy and does not check all DAL writes or make base/points/counter atomic; those are deficiencies, not safe local rules.
Any calibration_batch_group reference prohibits delete. Otherwise ask confirmation and set visible=false; original point/history rows remain. No explicit role gate in this slot.
UserPower::canDoPower(1) and confirmation required; set is_checked=true. This is distinct from batch selection/application.

Select/application requires permission>=Engineer. If project auto_apply is false and curve unchecked, asks to audit and requires UserPower(1). Stores project_name+batch_group -> calibration_id in calibration_batch_group; Default is literal default group. Project auto_apply true bypasses unchecked test. Local display selection must not write these effective mappings.
Method settings button hidden below Engineer; handler itself has no additional role check. Dialog save changes calculate_id/x_change/y_change then original page recalculates.

Only a repeat-test-value cell opens a task_id-linked raw measurement spectrum through MaskDlgSpectrumChart. This is a different chart from concentration/test-value calibration scatter and requires stored instrument measurement data.

original_entry_and_calls.function: calibration base creation during sample task preparation
original_entry_and_calls.behavior: Original calibration page does not have a blank New button. Initial base comes from sample calibration task: blood/calibrator batch, calibration id, datetime, project, point and repeat counts, Original and Calibration units, project method/transforms, visible=1.

data_contract.base_table: calibration_base: id PK AUTOINCREMENT, calibration_id INTEGER NOT NULL, project_name TEXT, calibration_datetime VARCHAR(yyyyMMddHHmmss serialization), boold_batch TEXT [original misspelling preserved], point_size INTEGER, repeat_number INTEGER, calculate_id TEXT, is_checked INTEGER, is_edited INTEGER, result_unit TEXT, con_unit TEXT, x_change TEXT, y_change TEXT, visible INTEGER
data_contract.point_table: calibration_data: id PK AUTOINCREMENT, calibration_id INTEGER NOT NULL, point_index TEXT bound as integer, sample_rate TEXT, concentration TEXT, result_flag TEXT, result_value TEXT, only_count TEXT; repeated results/flags/task ids delimited by |; queryDataByID orders by id
data_contract.association_table: calibration_batch_group: id PK AUTOINCREMENT, project_name VARCHAR NOT NULL, batch_group VARCHAR NOT NULL, calibration_id INTEGER NOT NULL. Distinct from reagent_batch_group. Independent local DB must not claim cross-DB foreign key/atomicity.
data_contract.units: result_unit belongs to raw Original test values; con_unit belongs to stored concentration. Current original UI displays Calibration unit from live project result metadata and multiplies stored concentration by unit dictionary multiplier; inverse divide occurs on Save. Local immutable unit snapshots are an intentional protection from later catalog unit edits.
data_contract.calibrator_batch: boold_batch/ldtBooldBatch: .ui marks readOnly false, but init_components at line207 sets readOnly(true); runtime original is read-only
data_contract.numeric_edit_validation: set_table_result_data requests nonnegative 0..99999, decimalCount4, through SystemCommon lineValidator_Integer (helper naming/precision semantics need Windows behavior comparison). No safe rule for clinically valid ranges inferred from this input filter.
data_contract.unsafe_original_averaging: queryDataByID counts numeric nonzero results but sums every task-linked result; get_calibration_result_data and ReCalculate divide by numeric repeat count without zero-count guard. Invalid text may become sentinel -999/****. Local implementation should reject invalid nonfinite/empty repeat values and define purely arithmetic raw means explicitly, without presenting it as calibration fitting.

plot_contract.axes: Final chart x=concentration (display multiplier applied), y=raw Original test value. CalibrationChart explicitly labels axes 浓度 / 测试值.
plot_contract.point_glyph: Original tag graph: no line, QPen(QColor(120,120,120),3), black ssCross marker size10.
plot_contract.fitted_line: Original line graph: calibrationStyle::getColorLine(), width3, from unverified vendor algorithm output. A local raw scatter must not synthesize this fitted line or report r/formula/inverse values.
plot_contract.transforms: caculateValue initially constructs(mean,concentration); it applies y_change to mean and x_change to concentration, then finally swaps into (transformed concentration,transformed mean) for scatter. Raw-only display should leave values untransformed and explicitly say transformations/fitting unavailable.
plot_contract.unsupported_original_method: 双线回归法 is listed in header/dialog but caculateValue switch only handles indices1..4; default returns false. Do not silently enable method5.
plot_contract.algorithm_risk: AL4A_OLD is commented out. Active algorithmcore.cpp non-Windows branches of LinearFit(lines679-720), PolyFit(723-766), SplineFit(769-814), CorTransfor(834-863), CorReturn(866-893) discard inputs and return success. These branches are not Linux implementations and must not be reused as successful fit/transform/inverse calculations.

visual_contract.original_business_extent: Right action bar extends to x1751 y968. Root .ui has no top layout; panel groups use absolute geometry.
visual_contract.local_colors: init_components: project CusView white radius10, curve background #F6F6F6 radius10, detail panel white radius15 border #E4E8EB. Text #444444, unselected tabs #AAAAAA, selected tabs #444444 and 5px theme matchColor border. No button icon property is present in original .ui; iconSize alone does not establish an icon.
visual_contract.font_source: 苹方 粗体 in UI/dynamic QSS, chart 黑体 pointsize10. Linux font substitution needs explicit evidence and separate Windows comparison.
visual_contract.theme_loading: Original main.cpp getConfig lines94-159 reads theme_config.ini else config.ini, propagates visual keys into kThemeColors/kIntThemeColors and stylecolor setters. No theme config was read during this audit. Existing working shell/origins.json documents shipped visual keys: right base28,28,28; right button127,127,127; white foreground; ordinary button42,118,242; hover alpha170; pressed135,206,250; accent232,51,35. That established source baseline is available for reuse, but original active Windows theme remains unverified.
visual_contract.shared_styles: Constructor uses buttonStyle::getStrSheet, listWidgetStyle::getStrSheet, tableStyle3(curve list),4(batch list),5(points). Exact source functions and hashes are attached. Active selection color is injected through tableStrColor/listStrSheet and is not a fixed literal inside these functions.
visual_contract.pending: Original active Windows run/theme/same-state screenshot, real raw measurement chart, clinically valid input ranges/parameters, accepted fit/inverse cases, RK1600x900 actual screen/input, instrument, resource budget and long stability remain unverified.

required_local_regressions: Empty catalog/project/curve selection and empty point array do not dereference null or show stale plot.
Explicit horizontal/vertical units and stable project ID/snapshot survive later rename, removal, unit changes and batch removal.
Point order, duplicate concentration, numeric zero, all empty, NaN/Inf/negative/huge/invalid text and varying repeat counts have defined local-only behavior.
Save/Copy/Delete cancellation changes neither committed DB nor current committed selection. Copy uses committed snapshot or explicitly documents changed behavior.
Lock/write error/partial point write rolls back base and points together, retains editable draft, reports real error and permits retry.
Soft deletion preserves history and any active/effective/shared reference prevents unsafe removal; absent cross-DB protection is stated.
Pending asynchronous reply cannot overwrite later project/curve/session selection; duplicate clicks bounded, busy state and normal shutdown drain correctly.
Local display selection, local save and local record linkage never mark checked/applied or write clinical effective mappings.
